selection.basis: Select eight stale, non-50-approach gaps among six exact model families and seven variant records. The newest scoped gap attempts are dated 2026-09-22; none is a retry-after-future item. This excludes the active 50-area campaigns, same-day 2026-09-24 retries, and the unresolved SEKA ExAero versus ExAero RDC family lead.
selection.evidence_only_writer: one Luna Max agent; sequential model/source research; no repository writes
selection.root_writer: integrate only evidence that meets the exact target contract

targets.guardrails: Keep frame-only weights separate from complete-build weights; do not transfer measurements from the previous-generation non-UDH frame.
Keep model-year, frame generation, size and bare-frame-versus-build bases explicit; do not borrow a nearby V3 generation.
Seek the manufacturer's maximum for the exact frame generation and 1x/2x configuration; distinguish fit reports from maximum clearance.
A foreign or quote-only amount is not a current mainland price. Use stiffness evidence only from a controlled or sufficiently specific exact-frame assessment; marketing adjectives do not qualify.
Only a dated, exact-option mainland CNY listing or checkout observation counts as observed price; preserve seller and package uncertainty.
A foreign direct-sale amount or other CX-002 generation is not a mainland 2023 observed price. Keep frame and build package explicit.
Preserve exact CIMA trim and mainland package; a regional or official list price is not a mainland observed checkout.

delivery: Local B52 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
